verdict: VERDICT: FAIL (SEMANTIC - 4 Blocking Defect Groups on Frozen 2cc)

probe_summary.negative_control: PASS (Baseline readTextFile on supported Core env returns ok)

open_findings.title: Unsupported operations and metadata reported as success
open_findings.evidence: Probe 1.1 shows flushFile returns ok(undefined) instead of typed err(FileError('not_supported')); Probe 1.2 shows listFiles hardcodes kind='file' and truncated=false; Probe 1.3 shows constructor generates random id instead of preserving coreEnv.id; Probe 1.4 shows fileInfo forces kind='file' when neither isFile nor isDirectory is true.
open_findings.impact: Caller receives fabricated durability, completeness, and file kind guarantees on an unbacked environment, violating AP-026 and AP-076.

open_findings.title: Permission, cancellation and unknown errors masquerade as missing files
open_findings.evidence: Probe 2.1 shows readTextFile maps EACCES to FileError('not_found'); Probe 2.2 shows exists returns ok(false) when statFile throws EACCES; Probe 2.3 shows readTextFile ignores cancelled context and calls Core readFile; Probe 2.4 shows toFileError prioritizes 'not found' text over structured EACCES code.
open_findings.impact: Caller treats inaccessible or unread files as non-existent, leading to silent authorization masking and false absence logic.

open_findings.title: Async environment cache and cleanup do not ensure single ownership
open_findings.evidence: Probe 3.1 demonstrates concurrent same-key getOrCreate calls create multiple distinct adapter instances; Probe 3.2 demonstrates same Core instance mapped to 2 keys has cleanup called twice; Probe 3.3 demonstrates cleanup loop aborts on first rejection, skipping remaining environments; Probe 3.4 demonstrates legacy string ctor without factory does not throw fail-fast error; Probe 3.5 demonstrates in-flight creations during cleanup are not drained, leaking late-resolved environments.
open_findings.impact: Concurrent tool execution creates duplicate environments, double disposal, and resource leakage during or after cleanup.

open_findings.title: Core exec pretends to implement unsupported native Shell semantics
open_findings.evidence: Probe 4.1 shows exec with onOutput completes Core exec then replays stdout/stderr post-hoc instead of rejecting with shell_unavailable; Probe 4.2 shows exec silently ignores spill/window/inheritEnv options; Probe 4.3 shows exec ignores context cancellation; Probe 4.4 shows exec fails to refuse cancellable contexts up front despite pure Core having no cancellation contract.
open_findings.impact: Caller receives false streaming, isolation, and cancellation guarantees on an unstreamed command runner.
